widgets_values:
Generate short clips with sound in real time with FastH3. Queue the prompt and its clip plays in the Reactor Realtime window. Write the next clip's prompt there and press Queue new shot, or Queue continuation to carry on from the last clip's final frame. Press Save to save the take under reactor/realtime, or Cancel to drop it.

A new shot starts from nothing, so its prompt describes the whole scene again, and its sound as well as its picture.

FastH3 prompt guide: https://docs.reactor.inc/model-api-reference/fast-h3/prompt-guide

Set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.

widgets_values: A small harbor at dawn, pale pink sky over still grey water. An old fisherman in a yellow raincoat coils rope on the deck of a wooden boat tied to the pier. Static medium wide shot from the pier, eye-level. Gulls cry overhead, water laps against the hull, and the rope creaks as he pulls it tight.
